verdict.rationale: Weaviate documents native multi-tenancy in which each tenant is stored on a separate shard, data is not visible across tenants, and tenants can be created automatically via `autoTenantCreation`. That covers the isolation mechanism well. The story's "cheaply" and "documented limits" elements are not evidenced at all. Missing for 10: documented tenant-count limits per collection or node, evidence of cost-efficient tenant storage (e.g. offloading or deactivating inactive tenants), and independent or hands-on corroboration of multi-tenant scale.
